On it, Dwarf hit 8.6% against the 8% yellow cap, the set's own hit 5.6%: 0.6% (6 budget points) re-spent over the set's shares at the 1b prices (Agility 57.6%, CritRating 14.5%, Intellect 13.0%, AttackPowerBoth 12.7%, RangedAttackPower 2.2%). Hit and crit are one pool for the gear, so each is written once. Dwarf 973.2 with the set, 976.9 with the swap; gain.se is the paired error (the same seeded fights), 0.27 unpaired.
